sub_agent_reviews.summary: One merged Scout covered llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety; arXiv had no matching 2026-06-29 UTC papers, so the table pivoted to current GitHub/official updates and selected JamJet after duplicate and WIP candidates were rejected.
Main agent read the JamJet README, CHANGELOG, docs index, runtime notes, governance/session/team/replay/policy/guardrail source files, tests, and evidence placeholders.
Article is pure Markdown with more than 5000 Chinese characters, no external image embeds, and evidence represented through tables, formula-style blocks, pseudocode, and Mermaid.
